accessories.notes: Development-board alternative to the bare WROOM module; not an extra fitted part on I0. USB-UART GPIO44 and revision-dependent LED GPIO48 require physical isolation where documented.
Alternative to the bare H2-MINI on I0. Verify module marking and flash size; onboard USB-UART can conflict with the host TX connection.

accessories.model: I0 JST XH harness housings: XHP-8, XHP-5, XHP-4, 2 × XHP-6
accessories.notes: Matches J3–J5 and service J7/J8: 29 SXH-001T-P0.6 contacts total when all are populated; service harnesses can be shared. J6 uses a separate precrimped 4-pin QT cable. Use connector pin atlas, not wire colors.

accessories.model: I0 external modules: ZAC93, CC1101, HLK-LD2450, Adafruit 3660
accessories.notes: These modules are not fitted to I0 and are not included in its 106 assembly rows. Their individual identification cards appear in the LP-P0 reference. Add the matched 433.92 MHz antenna and 4-pin QT cable; verify any cable already included in a module kit.

accessories.model: 3.3 V SWD debug probe supporting Silicon Labs MGM240P
accessories.notes: Use a compatible J-Link / Silicon Labs debug adapter, target-voltage sense and ground. The service harness is not a standard ARM connector: map each signal using the pin atlas. Do not connect 5 V UART signals.

accessories.model: 3.3 V USB UART adapter plus USB data cable
accessories.notes: Verify signal voltage, not just the power jumper. Use the documented boot/reset sequence; avoid two powered outputs driving the same UART signal.

accessories.model: Temperature-controlled soldering station, flux, tweezers and magnification
accessories.notes: I0 and M0 require suitable SMT/reflow capability, inspection and continuity testing. Bare PCBs are not plug-in kits. Match soldering equipment to the selected board assembly route.

accessories.model: JST XH / SH compatible crimp tooling and wire stripper
accessories.notes: Use tooling appropriate for the exact contact and wire gauge; precrimped QT leads avoid attempting SH crimps with an XH die. Pull-test crimps and continuity-test both ends before power.

accessories.model: DMM, current-limited bench supply, DC load and power meter
accessories.notes: Required to verify polarity, shorts, supply droop, regulator heat and actual always-on energy. This gallery does not remove open prototype qualification gates.

accessories.model: 433.92 MHz 50 Ω antenna matched to the existing CC1101 module
accessories.notes: Confirm SMA versus RP-SMA and gender from the real module. S3-WROOM-1, H2-MINI-1 and MGM240PA22VNA3 have integrated antennas; do not add pigtails to their unconnected RF pads. Keep all antenna clearance regions free.
